02/11.03.2025

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Koderma P.S. Case No. 50 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 420/467/468/471 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned C.J.M., Koderma.
On 16.03.2024, the petitioner is alleged to have interpolated the cheque of Rs. 1,00,000/- given by the informant to him.
It is alleged that he had interpolated the cheque by increasing the amount to Rs.81 lakhs and also encashed it.
It was submitted that though the money was transferred to the account of the petitioner, but the bank has frozen the account.
It was further submitted that from mere perusal of cheque, it does not appear that there was any interpolation in the cheque.
The dispute between the parties will be decided during the trial of the case.
In view of the submission made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly,
the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.
20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sanjeev Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
